runnerCompaction.label: Custom compaction
runnerCompaction.description: On: a chat’s compaction is written by <model>{{model}}</model> at {{effort}} effort instead of by the chat’s own model, in three cases:
runnerCompaction.descriptionBare: On: a chat’s compaction is written by the summarizer instead of by the chat’s own model, in three cases:
runnerCompaction.whenPressed: when you press Compact or type /compact;
runnerCompaction.atTurnEnd: at the end of a turn that leaves the chat past half its context window — never in the middle of work;
runnerCompaction.whenIdle: when the chat has sat idle for 54 minutes holding 200K tokens or more, in place of the CLI’s own idle compaction.
runnerCompaction.after: The chat moves to a new session seeded with the summary and its latest messages, and keeps its own model and effort. The CLI’s auto-compact stays on as the net. Chats placed on a node are compacted the same way. A flip reaches each chat at its next message.

runnerMainSessionDactyls.label: Dactyls for the main session
runnerMainSessionDactyls.description: On: the main session — a chat here or a terminal session — changes a repository file only through a dactyl, a <model>{{model}}</model> child at {{effort}} that sees only its brief and the files it is given.
runnerMainSessionDactyls.descriptionBare: On: the main session — a chat here or a terminal session — changes a repository file only through a dactyl, a child that sees only its brief and the files it is given.
runnerMainSessionDactyls.hands: Its own Edit and Write into repository files are refused, and so are its shell writes there; files outside any repository (scratch in /tmp), git-ignored files and /remember are untouched. Shell dumps of a repository file’s body (cat, head, tail, sed) are refused too: what a file says comes through dactyl --read, so its body never enters its context, and the Read tool keeps exact lines. A /tweak lands through a dactyl, and rail 2 logs it on the chain the file belongs to.
runnerMainSessionDactyls.after: A session that cannot reach a dactyl keeps its own hands. A flip reaches each session at its next message. The dactyl’s words are edited in Edit Agent Chains.
runnerMainSessionDactyls.waiting: Waiting: <why>{{why}}</why>. Sessions keep their own hands until it can.
